# last-price-auth: tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync.mjs from the live tools/list. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every tool below is on the Last Price MCP server (`https://api.last-price.ai/api/mcp/rpc?profile=directory`).
The connector lists a short set of tools in `tools/list`; every other tool below is still on the server.
Find an unlisted tool with `search_tools` (pass its name or the job as `query`; the answer carries its full input schema),
then run it with `call_tool`: `{"name": "<tool>", "arguments": {...}}`. Most clients also accept a direct call by name.
A tool `search_tools` cannot find is not switched on for your connection yet.

## `register_agent`

Sign up with no key and no human: creates a sandbox workspace of your own and returns its API key (shown once), its daily limits and a claim link a person can open to take the workspace into their…

- **How to call:** not in `tools/list`: `call_tool` with `{"name": "register_agent", "arguments": {...}}`
- **Access:** key
- **Behaviour:** changes data

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `name` **(required)** | string | What to call this agent, such as your-system/role-name: letters, digits, spaces and . |
| `contact_email` | string | Where a person can reach whoever runs this agent. |
| `intended_use` | string | What the agent will price, in a sentence. |

## `use_api_key`

Use a Last Price API key you already hold (a saved file, LASTPRICE_API_KEY) in this MCP connection, when it was opened without one: pass api_key.

- **How to call:** not in `tools/list`: `call_tool` with `{"name": "use_api_key", "arguments": {...}}`
- **Access:** key
- **Behaviour:** changes data

| Argument | Type | Meaning |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `api_key` **(required)** | string | Your Last Price API key: lp_ and 40 lowercase hex characters. |
